To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Bayesian networks are a useful tool for decision support in environmental management.

1) Bayesian networks provide a flexible framework for multi-criteria decision analysis, and 2) Bayesian networks can be used to model and visualize trade-offs between multiple objectives in a complex decision problem.
